\caption{\textbf{Phasing compared with further phasers.} HG002, replicate~1; nanopore R10.4.1 data at 10--60$\times$ in steps of 10$\times$ and PacBio HiFi data at 10--50$\times$. Each block compares tools given the same reads, variant calls and variant classes; within a block, \toolname is listed first. MethPhaser was given the SNV-only output of \toolname without GNN correction. HiPhase and TinkerHap have no SNV-only mode, so their SNV-only rows used call sets restricted to SNVs. LongHap with indels, SVs and 5mC was given deletions and insertions from Sniffles2 as sequence-resolved records. Switch error rates are over consecutive SNV pairs; Hamming distance includes indels where both files contain them, so it is comparable only within a block. Phased fractions are percentages of benchmark heterozygous SNVs or indels; --, not applicable.
